clue.text: (& 11ac.) Nightfall conceals near pissed Secretary of State

indicators.note: to conceal something is to hold it hidden within, so one word wraps round the other
pissed is slang for drunk, and drunken letters stagger out of their proper order

blocks.note: dusk is the time when night falls
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A drunk US Secretary of State lurks in the twilight, a cheerfully scurrilous Private Eye picture.
explanation.walkthrough: The jumbled letters sit after the D of DUSK, giving D-EANR-USK.
explanation.definitionFit: Dean Rusk served as US Secretary of State under Presidents Kennedy and Johnson in the 1960s.

explanation.walkthrough: Drop the middle initial W from George W Bush and you are left with the name of his father, the earlier president.
explanation.definitionFit: George Bush senior was president from 1989 to 1993, so he preceded his son in the office.
